description: M2 posture v0.1: reference calibration + centroid/energy features + contrast quality gate + threshold classification with reject guards. On current T01 hardware data the person signature is buried under TX leakage; the contrast gate is expected to reject classification (posture=unknown, calibration_status=invalid) on all current dev recordings. Gate parameters are the enforceable form of the dev-set diagnostics (posture_v01_diagnostics.md).
